# appgatesdp_dns_policy (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Read-Only

- `administrative_roles` (List of String) List of Administrative Role IDs in this Policy.
- `apply_fallback_site` (Boolean) The Entitlements in this Policy will be available in the fallback Sites if the corresponding Sites are configured accordingly.
- `block_local_dns_requests` (Boolean) Whether the Windows Client will block local DNS requests or not. Supported in API versions: v23, v24, v25.
- `client_profile_settings` (Attributes) Profiles that admins can apply to the Client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_profile_settings))
- `client_settings` (Attributes) Settings that admins can apply to the Client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_settings))
- `created` (String) Create date.
- `custom_client_help_url` (String) Set custom help URL on Client UI.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If true, the Policy will be disregarded during authorization.
- `dns_settings` (Attributes List) List of domain names with DNS server IPs that the Client should be using. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_settings))
- `entitlement_links` (List of String) List of Entitlement tags in this Policy.
- `entitlements` (List of String) List of Entitlement IDs in this Policy.
- `expression` (String) A JavaScript expression that returns boolean. Criteria Scripts may be used by calling them as functions.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `override_nearest_site` (Boolean) Overrides the Entitlements Site according to location of the client and Sites where this feature is enabled.
- `override_site` (String) Site ID where all the Entitlements of this Policy must be deployed. This overrides Entitlement's own Site and to be used only in specific network layouts. Otherwise the assigned site on individual Entitlements will be used.
- `override_site_claim` (String) The path of a claim that contains the UUID of an override site. It should be defined as "claims.xxx.xxx" or "claims.xxx.xxx.xxx".
- `proxy_auto_config` (Attributes) Client configures PAC URL on the client OS. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_auto_config))
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `ringfence_rule_links` (List of String) List of Ringfence Rule tags in this Policy.
- `ringfence_rules` (List of String) List of Ringfence Rule IDs in this Policy.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `tamper_proofing` (Boolean) Will enable Tamper Proofing on desktop clients which will make sure the routes and ringfence configurations are not changed. Will be set to true if it's not provided and the type is "Device".
- `trusted_network_check` (Attributes) Client suspends operations when it's in a trusted network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trusted_network_check))
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--client_profile_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client_profile_settings`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable Client Profile Settings for this Policy.
- `force` (Boolean) Makes the client skip the user prompt and apply the profiles immediately. Required to be true to apply the settings when authorization fails, such as in case of Stop Policies.
- `profiles` (List of String) List of profiles.


<a id="nestedatt--client_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client_settings`

Read-Only:

- `add_remove_profiles` (String) Allow adding and removing profiles on Client.
- `attention_level` (String) Set the Attention Level automatically on Client and hide the option. "Show" will leave option to the user.
- `auto_start` (String) Set the Autostart setting automatically on Client and hide the option. "Show" will leave option to the user.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable Client Settings for this Policy.
- `entitlements_list` (String) Show or hide Entitlement List on Client UI.
- `keep_me_signed_in` (String) Set the "Keep me signed-in" setting for credential providers automatically on Client and hide the option. "Show" will leave option to the user.
- `new_user_onboarding` (String) Show or hide the tooltips for new users on Client UI as well as the arrival messages on Portal. As of 6.4, Client has no longer tooltips so this setting only affects the arrival messages on Portal.
- `quit` (String) Show or hide "Quit" on Client UI.
- `saml_auto_sign_in` (String) Set the "SAML/Certificate auto sign-in" setting automatically on Client and hide the option. "Show" will leave option the user.
- `sign_out` (String) Show or hide "Sign out" on Client UI.
- `suspend` (String) Show or hide "Suspend" feature on Client UI.


<a id="nestedatt--dns_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_settings`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The domain for which the DNS servers should be used by the client.
- `register_tun_ips_to_active_directory` (Boolean) Enables a Windows feature to register Appgate TUN IPs to the Active Directory for this domain.
- `servers` (List of String)


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_auto_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_auto_config`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `persist` (Boolean) If true Client will leave the PAC URL configured after signing out.
- `url` (String) The URL to set on the Client OS.


<a id="nestedatt--trusted_network_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trusted_network_check`

Read-Only:

- `dns_suffix` (String) Client checks if the DNS suffix has been configured on the OS to decide whether it's on a trusted network or not.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
